hypothesis: Root cause: the source database's pg_hba.conf now requires scram-sha-256 and the debezium password was rotated, so the connector cannot authenticate.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis places the authentication failure at the Postgres source (pg_hba.conf), not at the Kafka broker SASL authentication of User:debezium. That puts both the first failing layer and the root-cause layer at postgres, so the root cause is wrong even though it mentions a rotated password.
